kv18.4:1.1: Buddhassa Bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya aññe gandhajāte adhigaṇhātīti?
kv18.4:1.7: Hañci Bhagavā odanakummāsaṃ bhuñjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv18.4:1.8: "Buddhassa Bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya aññe gandhajāte adhigaṇhātīti." 2.
kv18.4:2.1: Buddhassa Bhagavato uccārapassāvo ativiya aññe gandhajāte adhigaṇhātīti?
kv18.4:2.3: Atthi keci Buddhassa Bhagavato uccārapassāvaṃ nahāyanti vilimpenti uccārenti, peḷāya patisāmenti, karaṇḍāya nikkhipenti, āpaṇe pasārenti, tena ca gandhena gandhakaraṇīyaṃ karontīti?
